attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the L3 router between node2 and node3 over two new transit subnets (172.20.1.0/24 via eth1 to node2, 172.20.2.0/24 via eth2 to node3), enabled forwarding, and added an nftables FORWARD rule on node1 that rejects TCP port 23 in both directions between the two links while leaving all other forwarded traffic (including TCP 8080 and ICMP) untouched. Verified functionality in both directions, persisted the config, then restarted all three nodes one at a time (node2, node3, node1) and re-verified boot-id change, config recovery, and the port-8080-allowed/port-23-refused behavior after every node was rebooted.
